# Cannikin 1971 IRIS waveform cache

Placeholder. Cannikin predates the IRIS open-data window; cached
observed waveforms exist in published archives (Lay et al 1984
digitized analog records for the BSSA paper) but a fetcher that
ingests them into the FSRM cache layout does not ship.

## Event metadata

- USGS event: us1971.11.06
- Origin time (UTC): 1971-11-06 22:00:00
- Hypocenter: 51.47 N, 179.10 E (Amchitka Island, Aleutian Arc)
- Body-wave magnitude: mb 6.97
- Yield: ~5 Mt (estimated; classified)
